en: Itivuttaka 20:
Ekakanipāta,
Second Chapter (Dutiyavagga)
The Discourse on a Corrupt Mind.
This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant; thus have I heard:
"In this case, monks, having encompassed with my own mind the mind of a certain person whose mind is corrupt, I understand it thus: [I know that his mind is corrupted by lust, hatred, and delusion]."
‘And if this person were to pass away at this very moment, they would be placed in hell as if carried there.
For what reason?
Because, monks, their mind is corrupted.
“Monks, it is because of mental corruption that some beings here, with the breakup of the body, after death, reappear in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a lower realm, even in hell.
Thus spoke the Blessed One. With reference to this, it is said:
“Having known that a certain person here has a corrupted mind,
he explained this matter.”
In the presence of the monks and the Buddha—
at this very moment,
if a person were to pass away;
He would be reborn in hell,
for his mind has been corrupted;
as if one were to carry him away and cast him there.
In this very way,
such beings go to an evil destination because of the cause of mental corruption.
This matter too was spoken by the Blessed One; thus have I heard.
The tenth [sutta].
The second chapter.
Its summary verse (uddāna) is:
Delusion, anger, and then hypocrisy;
clear knowledge, craving, and the two types of trainees.
A person who causes schism is called a "schismatic";
they are said to be the second member of the faction.
